title: Posterior Frequencies and the Cost of Not Fitting: A Correction to a Memorization Lower Bound
abstract: arXiv:2610.20402v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feldman's memorization lower bound assigns a frequency coefficient based on how often a point appears in the training sample. We give an exact three-point counterexample to its conditional and averaged forms, using independent fair labels and a permutation-equivariant learner. A sequence of sampling priors makes the ratio of the proposed penalty to actual excess risk grow exponentially, ruling out a universal positive constant-factor repair. The priors vary with sample size, the offending profiles become rare, and both quantities vanish. Retaining the original model, we obtain an exact replacement using full-sample posterior probabilities. Under exchangeability, these depend on multiplicity and the complete frequency profile. We characterize the largest multiplicity-only coefficients valid for unrestricted learners. translated_title: 后验频率与不拟合的代价：对记忆化下界的一个修正
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.20402v1 公告类型：cross（交叉发布） 摘要：Feldman 的记忆化下界根据数据点在训练样本中出现的频率来赋予其频率系数。我们利用独立公平的标签和一个置换等变的学习器，构造了一个精确的三点反例，否定了其条件形式与平均形式。通过构造一列采样先验，使所提出的惩罚项与实际超额风险之比呈指数增长，从而排除了任何普遍的正常数因子修复的可能性。这些先验随样本量变化，出问题的频率剖面变得稀有，且两个量都趋近于零。在保留原有模型的前提下，我们用全样本后验概率得到了一个精确的替代结果。在可交换性条件下，这些后验概率取决于出现次数（多重性）以及完整的频率剖面。我们刻画了对无限制学习器有效的、仅依赖多重性的最大系数。原始系数具有 Good 精确频率公式的后验均值形式，并且是一种占用加权平均。
tldr: 本文通过精确的三点反例证明 Feldman 记忆化下界中的频率系数不成立且无法用普遍正常数因子修复，并基于全样本后验概率给出了一个精确的替代系数。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an exact three-point counterexample showing that the frequency coefficient in Feldman's memorization lower bound fails and admits no universal positive constant-factor repair, and derives an exact replacement based on full-sample posterior probabilities.
